observation: Front, top and iso all show one coherent body: a 34 mm disc with a rounded top edge, a short conical seat, and a 21 mm globe carrying raised continental relief and a lobed polar ice field. The seven-segment numeral 4 stands off the front of the disc wall and reads as a 4 at the front view. Nothing is misplaced, missing, duplicated, floating or intersecting; the top view confirms the globe is concentric with the disc and clears its rim by about 6.5 mm on every side.
